name: valetkey
description: A browser that is logged in to one site and can reach only the hosts that site needs, through valetkey.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to valetkey, which must be installed on the same Linux machine. The agent gets a headless browser signed in to one site, contained by a network namespace and a proxy that allows only the hosts that site needs.

tools.name: browser_sites
tools.description: List the sites the person has set up: each one's state (no session, login window open or session running), when they last logged in, the first few hosts it may reach and the ones left out or denied, and what the last login learned (shown once).

tools.name: browser_login
tools.description: Open a login window on the person's own screen so they can sign in to a site.

tools.name: browser_open
tools.description: Start the signed-in browser for a site, or join the one already running, and load its start page.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Read the page: a text tree of what is on it, with its text (paragraphs, lists, tables) and references (e1, e2, ...) for the elements you can click or type into.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click an element, named by its reference (e3) from your latest browser_snapshot, or by its visible text with an optional role.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Replace the contents of a field, by its reference from the latest browser_snapshot.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Go to a URL in the site's browser.

tools.name: browser_save
tools.description: Save a picture, a video or a linked file from the page into the site's downloads folder, so the person can have it.

tools.name: browser_downloads
tools.description: List the files this site's browser has downloaded, with their size and a type guessed from the content, and downloads still running.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the page and return it as an image.

tools.name: browser_allow
tools.description: Ask the person to let a site's browser reach more hosts.

tools.name: browser_deny
tools.description: Ask the person to stop a site's browser reaching hosts it reaches now.

tools.name: browser_microphone
tools.description: Ask the person to turn on the microphone for a site, so that its browser can record audio for a call.
